newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh vessel with 650 tonnes cement sinks.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh vessel with 650 tonnes cement sinks.

text.p: A Bangladeshi vessel carrying 650 tonnes of cement sank near Chittagong port on Thursday, port officials said.
They said the M.V. Atlander, which was unloading cement from the Chinese-flagged freighter Bo Xing Hai, sank around noon, and its crew were rescued by another vessel.
The 2,000 gross-ton Atlander hit the sunken wreckage of another vessel while fleeing a pirate attack on Wednesday night and developed several cracks.
The freighter had anchored outside Chittagong port on Sunday with 17,200 tonnes of cement on board, port officials said without giving further details.
